items.wrong: She is more tall than me.

items.why: After did, use the base verb.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: She is more tall than me. → She is taller than me. | Did you lost? → Did you lose? | My serve was more bad. → My serve was worse..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

errors.w: She is more tall than me.

facts.label: Contar e comparar
facts.sub: Use was/were e verbos no passado: I practiced. She won. Compare com -er + than: She’s taller than me. Pergunte Did you…?

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para o passado simples, use verbos com -ed (played, practiced) ou formas irregulares (won, lost). Use was e were para ser e estar: The lesson was fun. Para perguntar, use did.

facts.label: Comparativos
facts.sub: Adjetivos curtos ganham -er e than: taller than, faster than, heavier than. Good vira better e bad vira worse. Para adjetivos longos, use more.
